description: This file defines the Todo class representing a to-do item, including serialization and deserialization methods, copy, and string representation.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: Represents a to-do item with properties like id, title, description, completion status, due date, created and updated timestamps, with methods for JSON conversion, copying, and string representation.

methods.name: Todo.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Todo instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toUpdateJson
methods.description: Converts the Todo object into a JSON map suitable for update requests.

methods.name: toCreateJson
methods.description: Converts the Todo object into a JSON map suitable for create requests.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Todo object, updating specified fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a JSON-encoded string representation of the Todo object.
